scientific_integrity: Proof includes renewal, Frechet limit, uniform optimizer tightness and Laplace principle; finite numerical quadrature only supports finite consistency.
scientific_limitations: Idealized all-in-one-epoch quorum with fully erased progress and zero reset overhead; independent arrival-rank models are different. Exact large-N fixed-rate and optimally scaled limits; no uniqueness of limiting minimizer or finite-N convergence rate proven. Closest 2026 rank-paper full text was inaccessible; its abstract and related published 2023 result were compared. No independent audit.
title: A synchronized-reset quorum law: stretched-exponential costs and inverse-square optimal clock scaling
